description: This Java class represents a specific implementation of the PipelineElement interface, signifying an unresolved pipeline element in a processing chain. It follows the singleton pattern with a static INSTANCE, providing behavior for handling unresolved states, including visitor acceptance and iteration.

classes.name: PipelineElementUnresolved
classes.description: A singleton class representing a pipeline element that has unresolved status, indicating a failed or pending resolution process.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the pipeline element, specifically indicating it is unresolved.

methods.name: onResolved
methods.description: Handles the event when the pipeline element is resolved; here, it simply returns itself as it is already unresolved.

methods.name: onUnresolved
methods.description: Handles the event for unresolved elements, returning the next pipeline element provided by the supplier.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion events; here, it simply returns itself.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing PipelineElementVisitor and calls the unresolved() method.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the element, which is empty for this unresolved singleton.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the class name as the string representation of this object.
